description.en: Real session deletion with trash and restore, archived cleanup, and batch delete from settings.
description.zh: 真正删除会话：回收站可还原、归档清理、设置页批量删除。

description.en: Playwright-powered browser automation for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: dsh-browser — DSH 插件（工具）

description.en: Rust 实现的 Windows 原生 POSIX bash 执行器：给 DSH 提供一个真正的 bash（brush 引擎，不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），支持 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具
description.zh: 在 Windows 上直接跑真正的 bash，不用装 WSL 或 MSYS，支持权限策略和后台作业。

description.en: 给 DSH 网页右下角请一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、视线跟着鼠标、点她有反应、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动。模型不用内置——谁装谁放自己的文件夹；支持自定义 .exp3.json 表情和 .motion3.json 动作，卡片能拖能缩，背景可换。
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页右下角放一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动，用自己的对话气泡聊天，记得住之前说过的，能喂语料，也会配表情包。模型不用内置，谁装谁放自己的文件夹。

description.en: Install Desert Ant Labs on-device models as DSH tools and skills, with per-platform capability gating

DeepSeek Harness 生图+生视频整合插件：统一供应商目录、三个工具、中转站实测的异步视频契约、 限流退避纪律、设置页+画廊+快车道 CLI。MIT，fork 合并自 dsh-image-generation 与 dsh-video-gen。| Unified image+video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness (MIT, fork-merge of dsh-image-generation & dsh-video-gen)
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 AI 生图和生视频，统一供应商配置，自带画廊和命令行，开箱即用。

description.en: DSH-Search-Contrl: a DSH skill/plugin for scoped web search and Chinese daily reports, with a settings GUI for custom search sources, arbitrary topics (not only tech), creator-link scoped search, and one-click rollback.
按物理像素截屏/录屏的 DSH 插件 | Native-pixel screenshots and screen recording for DSH
A writable, git-versioned self for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): persona files injected every turn, gated self-editing, journal→dream reflection, and a Settings › 人格 tab.
通过远程主机运行Claude与Codex会话。
查看远程主机连接状态并管理 Claude/Codex 登录。

Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view with a dedicated settings tab (themes that also color the settings page, flat / frosted-glass surfaces, fonts, save mode, AI prompt presets with a read-only preset preview, bu
description.zh: 在会话界面放一张当前工作区的便签浮窗，随手记问题和下一步，一键插入对话框。

description.en: 给 DSH 上的一个会话装上自己的目标、记忆和作息：goal / memory / clock 三个插件
AI Agent for Quantum Systems
把网页版 DeepSeek 接进 DSH 桌面端：内嵌面板 + 与 agent 会话双向搬运（带走/喂回去）

Quality-of-life enhancements for the DSH workspace sidebar: hide workspaces and their sessions, reveal them from the view options, and open any workspace folder in Finder, Explorer or your file manager. Display-only: workspace, session and archive data ar
让 DSH agent 识别微信/QQ 表情包与聊天截图并判断对方情绪（GLM-4V-Flash），暴露 wechat_emoji_analyze 工具。
Code-generated math & science animations for DeepSeek Harness: frames-first preview, Manim clips, formula checks.
description.zh: 用代码生成数学和科学动画，渲染 Manim 视频、抽帧检查、验证公式，适合做教学演示和科普内容。

description.en: 把 QQ 小号接进 DeepSeek Harness：收发消息、发表情包、发 QQ 空间说说、参与群聊，能自己找话题，自带启动与限速防封。
小猫娘破甲（快速版）— DSH 提示词注入插件，精简破甲内核，固定身份

Move a DeepSeek Harness conversation into another workspace: copies the transcript into a new session bound to the target folder, archives the original, and can register a new workspace folder from the picker.
description.zh: 从侧边栏菜单把已有的 DeepSeek Harness 会话移动到其他工作区：会话记录与标题一并带过去，可在同一对话框里登记新的工作区文件夹，原会话归档且可恢复。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one Feishu topic = one dsh session, in-card approvals and questions, streaming cards, model and permission switching, Web settings page, long connection with no public endpoint.
桌面小鲸鱼（桌宠版 DSH 插件）：余额 / 今日已用 / 悬停搜索框（可换搜索引擎）/ 情绪词库 / 网络梗 / 余额预警 / 预算提醒 / 用量记录 / ☰ 菜单 / 到点自己开口
DSH client plugin for dsh-mesh: turns a signed, content-free wake ping from the hub into a real session turn, with a settings page, inbox card and history cache.
DSH 插件：设置 →「MCP」页签，紧凑可折叠列表 + 表单/JSON 配置 MCP 服务，保存即生效，并展示每个服务已注册的工具。UI 复用 DSH 设计令牌与 primitives。
原产地区域价值成分核对（按 RVC 定义式与门槛核对原产地判定自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 自动核对原产地判定台账的算术，检查协议与产品申报、RVC 计算是否正确。

description.en: 让 AI 直接「读蓝湖（Lanhu）设计稿」—— 把设计稿解析成可直抄的精确数值（色值 / 字号 / 圆角 / 间距 / 文本），替代靠截图估算。
Experience Learning: learn conditional methods from outcome evidence, with optional export as skills.
政策专报要素核对（按观点、依据、出处与建议核对专报齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 帮你按政策专报要素核对表逐项检查草稿，看每段有没有观点、观点有没有证据支撑。

description.en: Visual browser for DeepSeek Harness: a right-sidebar tab under the built-in Browser that streams Chrome live as a binary JPEG frame stream (no screenshot polling) while the Agent drives it through a token-light numbered view of interactive elements, never
description.zh: 给 AI 助手配一个真 Chrome，侧边栏实时看它操作网页，省 token 又直观。

description.en: 劳动保护与安全防护用品配置表核对（按公开的配备标准核对品名规格与配置数量，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 按公开配备标准核对劳动防护用品配置表的品名、规格和数量，只提示差异，不下定性结论。

description.en: dsh plugin: persistent whole-machine LLM usage ledger with a markdown /llm-stats report (GFM tables + emoji: tokens, cache hit, model/tool time, per-day bars)
DSH Web 插件：模型供应商额度与用量（DeepSeek / GLM Coding Plan / OpenRouter / Kimi Coding + 自定义适配器）
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 里集中查看 DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、Kimi 等模型供应商的额度和用量，还能接自定义适配器。

description.en: Turn-granular context memory for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 按轮次自动记忆对话上下文，为后续压缩做准备，让长对话更连贯。

description.en: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host operations: restart dsh with a 3-second delay and a busy confirmation, restart once all sessions have been idle for 10s (cancellable, repeat clicks idempotent), last start time with uptime, and a dsh version/update check that compares npm dist-tags across selectable channels without upgrading. The same bundle replaces the sidebar brand area with a machine name, adds a read-only provider, model and thinking-level cell beside the composer stats pills, and a switch that registers or unregisters the three dsh_restart_* agent tools at runtime. Zero dependencies, no build step; all routes sit behind the connection trust fence.
description.zh: 放大 DSH Web 设置弹窗（默认 1180×920，20px 一档，只记本浏览器），并新增「设置 → 高级设置」页：同一页调尺寸，也收进 Host 运维——延迟 3 秒重启 dsh（忙时二次确认）、所有会话空闲 10 秒后自动重启（可取消、重复点击幂等）、最后启动时间与已运行时长，以及按所选 npm dist-tag 通道比较的 dsh 版本/更新提示（只提示、不代升级）。同一插件还用机器名字顶替侧栏品牌区、在输入框下方「性能与用量」行旁加一格只读的「供应商 · 模型 · 思考档位」，并提供一个即时注册/注销三个 dsh_restart_* 模型工具的开关。零依赖、无构建；所有路由都过官方信任围栏。

description.en: Agent Settings: manage reusable sub-agent profiles in the sidebar, each with a when-to-use description and its own provider/model route, and let the agent start the matching one as a subagent.
description.zh: 智能体设置：在侧边栏管理可复用的子智能体档案，为每个档案写明适用场景与所用提供方/模型，任务中由智能体按场景自动拉起对应的子智能体。

description.en: Windows-only model provider for Google Antigravity CLI, continuing Darkings/dsh-agy-provider (install as dsh-agy-cli; do not install alongside the original). It reads the Antigravity token from the Windows Credential Manager and sends it only to the Google Cloud Code endpoints, lets DSH own the harness tool policy, streams the tail without rollback, and tracks the real quota windows.
description.zh: Windows 专用的 Google Antigravity CLI 模型提供方，接续自 Darkings/dsh-agy-provider（包名 dsh-agy-cli，请勿与原版同装）。从 Windows 凭据管理器读取 Antigravity 令牌并只发往 Google Cloud Code 端点；Harness 工具策略由 DSH 全权负责，尾流式输出防回滚，并跟踪真实配额窗口。

description.en: Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading. Registers the annals skill, injects the write-it-down rules into the system prompt, and exposes three tools — annals_init builds the log directory, the index generator and a separate Git repository in one call; annals_query full-text searches past entries and returns them with file and line anchors; annals_links resolves which entry cites which. Reminds the agent once per turn when it changed files but wrote no log that day, and once more when the log was updated but the index was not. Adds a settings page for the six switches.
description.zh: 活过本次会话的记忆，载体是普通的每日日志文件：一天一个 markdown，外加一份生成出来的索引，让助手先用索引检索而不是重读全文。注册 annals 技能，把「写下来」的规矩注入系统提示词，并提供三个工具——annals_init 一次建好日志目录、索引生成器与独立的 git 仓库；annals_query 全文检索历史条目并带回文件与行号锚点；annals_links 查条目之间的双向引用。改过文件但当天没写日志时每轮提醒一次，写了日志却没更新索引时再提醒一次。另有设置页可关这六个开关。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject a pending approval from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; also reports turn completion and errors.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 授权通知：后台时可直接在通知上点「允许一次 / 拒绝」，前台时改走应用内审批框；另含完成 / 出错通知。

description.en: Read books in the DSH sidebar - import EPUB/TXT/Markdown, get a five-part close reading for every chapter (paragraph summary, best sentences, what the author is doing, the AI's own opinion, what is missing), listen with TTS, ask questions while listening, and export the whole book to one HTML page. Export collects the chapters that already have a close reading rather than unread chapters.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏读书：导入 EPUB/TXT/Markdown，逐章给出五段式精读（本段落概括 / 文章美句 / 作者表达 / AI 观点 / AI 认为需要补充点），可朗读、边听边问，还能把整本讲解导出成一份网页。导出只装订已经生成精读的章节，未读章节不会包含在内。

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为单个对话设置系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数，并提供低 token 的纯聊天模式。

description.en: Adds a Claude Pro/Max subscription model provider with OAuth login, multiple accounts, quota reporting and a settings panel. Requests are sent with the Claude Code client identity, and quota reporting uses an experimental endpoint.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录接入 Claude Pro/Max 订阅模型，支持多账号管理、额度查询和设置面板。请求使用 Claude Code 客户端身份发送，额度查询走实验性接口。

description.en: Task timing for DSH agents: a task_clock tool that measures elapsed time on the host monotonic clock, resumes across DSH or system restarts with the gap estimated, and returns unknown rather than inventing a number; it does not touch presets.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 的任务计时工具：task_clock 用宿主单调时钟测实际耗时，DSH 或系统重启后可续算并标注空档为估算，桥接不了时返回 unknown 而不是编造数字；不覆盖任何 preset。

description.en: Learns a user's coding conventions from instructions and corrections, stores them as confidence-scored rules in editable Markdown, and injects them as reference data into every session. Rules that decay out of range or contradict a newer rule stay visible for review instead of being applied.
description.zh: 从指令和纠正里学习编码习惯，存成带置信度、可手工编辑的 Markdown 规则，并在每个会话中作为参考数据注入。衰减出注入窗口或与更新规则冲突的条目会留在待审列表里，而不是继续生效。

description.en: Draws the sidebar navigation as a compact two-column grid at every viewport; on narrow, short or coarse-pointer screens it additionally caps the navigation at 34vh with scrolling so the workspace and session history keep a 38vh floor. Also repairs dsh-resource:// records whose protocol the browser URL parser reports as empty.
description.zh: 把侧栏导航在所有视口下都重画成紧凑双列网格；窄屏、矮窗口或粗指针设备上再加一层限制——导航最高 34vh 并允许滚动，给工作区与会话历史留出 38vh 下限。同时修复浏览器把 dsh-resource:// 记录协议判空导致的资源不可用。

description.en: Small-window mode for DSH NEXT on Windows: a 425px-wide always-on-top sticky window with a drawer sidebar and animated transitions. Requires DSH NEXT; the other desktop client (dsh desktop) is not supported.
description.zh: DSH NEXT（Windows）的小窗模式：把主窗口切成 425px 宽、置顶的便签式小窗，侧栏变抽屉、进出带过渡动效。只支持 DSH NEXT，另一个桌面端 dsh desktop 不支持。

description.en: Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary hallucination (paths, versions, ports and identifiers the summary invents that were never in the history it replaced), ghost references ("see above" pointing at removed text), token accounting (a summary nearly as large as what it claims to free), and unaccounted prunes. Four agent tools including a cross-session sweep that ranks conversations by how much compaction hurt them. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name.
description.zh: 压缩质量审计：审出上下文压缩到底丢了什么。读原始会话事件日志，检查会话约束幸存率（用户给的常驻指令—— 不要X、必须Y、只准Z——摘要是否还带着；arXiv 2608.11242 实测各压缩器平均只保留 17%）、摘要幻觉（摘要里 出现了历史中从不存在的路径/版本/端口/标识符）、幽灵引用（"如上所述"指向已不在上下文的内容）、token 记账（摘要几乎和它声称释放的一样大）、无据裁剪。四个 agent 工具，含跨会话扫描并按受损程度排序。纯 确定性，不调 LLM——答错就是规则有 bug，有名字可查。

description.en: Adds a Chat mode beside Work with a user-defined persona, long-term memory extracted after each turn and recalled by topic, and stickers it can save and send.
description.zh: 在「工作」之外加一个「聊天」模式：使用自定义人设，每轮自动提炼长期记忆并按话题召回，还能保存和发送表情包。

description.en: Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the model read every turn) and tool-schema inflation per plugin. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name. Four tools including a cross-session sweep.
description.zh: 每轮上下文预算审计：拆解一轮对话在 AGENTS.md、技能目录、工具 schema 与运行时上下文上各花了多少；把"内容 没变却每轮重发"标为纯浪费；排名技能目录膨胀（装 60+ 个技能时，模型每轮要读多少 token 的描述）与各插件的 工具 schema 占比。纯确定性，不调 LLM。四个工具，含跨会话扫描。

description.en: GitHub-style contribution grid in the Web sidebar showing how many prompts you sent each day, with a switch to count conversations, total tokens or output tokens instead. Counts only messages you sent yourself; injected context is excluded.
description.zh: Web 侧边栏的 GitHub 风格日历网格，按天展示你发出的对话条数，可切换为会话数、Token 总量或输出 Token。只统计你亲手发送的消息，注入的上下文不计入。

description.en: Count-up Pomodoro: focus counts up with no ceiling and never stops itself at 25 minutes, finishing drops straight into a short break, and a status board plus the four quadrants keep the task list in view.
description.zh: 正计时番茄钟：专注时段不设上限，不会在 25 分钟自动停止，结束即进入短休息；附带状态看板与四象限任务管理。

description.en: Manage $DSH_HOME/.env from Settings and sync Host plus Windows/macOS user environment.
description.zh: 在设置中管理 $DSH_HOME/.env，并同步到 Host 与 Windows/macOS 用户环境。

description.en: Export diagram-design HTML diagrams to SVG/PNG, extract draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw structure, validate output, and browse 45 diagram types. Built on cathrynlavery/diagram-design (MIT); needs python3, and PNG export additionally needs Playwright.
description.zh: 将 diagram-design 图表导出为 SVG/PNG，提取 draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw 结构，校验输出，并浏览 45 种图表类型。基于 cathrynlavery/diagram-design（MIT），需 python3，导出 PNG 还需 Playwright。

description.en: Per-conversation behavioral rule fence for DeepSeek Harness: rules live in one JSON file, are edited from a Settings page or the conversation panel, and are injected as a single runtime-context section at a fixed order so the system prompt prefix stays stable.
description.zh: 给每个对话加一道行为围栏：规则存在一个 JSON 文件里，可在设置页或对话面板里编辑，作为一段固定顺序的运行时上下文注入，不重写系统提示词前缀。

description.en: Marks paragraphs or a single code line in an answer and asks the model about it in a docked right-hand column, leaving the conversation itself unmodified.
description.zh: 点选回答中的段落或某一行代码，在右侧独立栏里向模型提问；左侧对话内容不被修改。

description.en: Two buttons beside the chat input: one rewrites the draft with the current directory in view, the other inserts a role template from 85 curated entries generated from the bundled `agents/` role library, which the settings card can extend with your own `.md` role files.
description.zh: 对话输入框旁的两个按钮：一个结合当前目录改写草稿，另一个插入角色模板——默认 85 条精选模板由随包携带的 `agents/` 角色库生成，设置卡可用自己的 `.md` 角色文件扩充。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: Document intake for agents: doc_route sniffs a file's real format by magic bytes and measures a PDF's text layer and page column layout before any conversion, and pdf_markdown converts PDFs to Markdown in column reading order with PyMuPDF. The PDF path needs a Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的文档入口：doc_route 先按魔数嗅探真实格式，并测量 PDF 的文本层与分栏版面，再给出该走的提取管线；pdf_markdown 用 PyMuPDF 按分栏阅读顺序把 PDF 转成 Markdown。PDF 路径需要带 PyMuPDF 的 Python 3 解释器。

description.en: Open ChatGPT Dots in a DSH page using the Desktop host WebView, with a theme-aware toolbar, refresh and external-browser controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH 页面中通过 Desktop 宿主 WebView 打开 ChatGPT Dots，提供随主题适配的工具栏、刷新及外部浏览器打开入口。

description.en: Expert center: browse and import WorkBuddy experts, create experts with AI, edit role.md and skills, and switch experts per session.
description.zh: 专家中心：浏览并导入 WorkBuddy 专家，用 AI 创建专家、编辑 role.md 与技能，并按会话切换专家。

description.en: See what a conversation actually costs: how many model requests, how big the system prompt and tool table are, cumulative tokens, estimated spend, and how far you are from automatic context compaction. Reads the local session log only; never calls a model, never adds a word to the system prompt. Token and spend figures are estimates from character counts, not provider usage.
description.zh: 看清一场对话到底烧了多少：模型请求次数、system prompt 与工具表各占多少、累计 token、估算花费、离上下文自动压缩还有多远。只读本地会话日志，不调模型，不往 system prompt 加一个字。token 与花费均按字符数估算，不是 provider 用量。

description.en: Session-level autonomy gears for DSH: a rail on the edge of the conversation area switches P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A and injects the active gear's behavioral prompt into every request; the model's set_gear tool can only downshift, and handbrake H blocks all tool calls. The set_gear tool can downshift on its own; upshifts need user approval.
description.zh: 会话级行动档位：对话区左缘的滑轨切换 P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A，并向每条请求注入当前档位的行为提示词；模型的 set_gear 只能降档，手刹 H 拦截全部工具调用。模型的 set_gear 只能自行降档，升档需用户在卡片上批准。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DSH: reads replies aloud, switches voices from the right sidebar, and trains a new voice from a dropped audio sample. First run downloads an 11.4 GB engine and needs an NVIDIA CUDA GPU.
description.zh: 基于 GPT-SoVITS 的本地语音合成：朗读 DSH 回复、在右侧边栏换音色，拖一段声音就能训练新音色。首次使用需下载约 11.4 GB 引擎，并要求 NVIDIA CUDA 显卡。

description.en: Adds a time-aware greeting line under the DSH home hero headline: seven local-time slots with tsundere whale-girl lines, phrase overrides through ~/.dsh/greeting.json, and Ctrl+R / F5 bound back to a real page reload.
description.zh: 给 DSH 主页 / 新会话 hero 区加一行按时段变化的问候语：按本地时间分 7 个时段随机抽句、内置傲娇鲸鱼娘台词、可用 ~/.dsh/greeting.json 覆盖任意时段，并顺手把 Ctrl+R / F5 接回页面刷新。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness activity as a GitHub-style contribution graph: an account-menu row opens a centred dialog with your avatar and name, a year of daily activity in five shades, a year picker and a tooltip on every day.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的日常活动画成 GitHub 风格的贡献热力图：账号菜单里的入口打开居中弹窗，含头像与用户名、按五档配色的一年活动、年份选择器与逐格 tooltip。

description.en: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML，点选元素或框选区域写批注，把选中项、当前样式与目标样式一起发进当前会话。

description.en: Iter Memory: it remembers my own state, not the facts. A level that drifts back to baseline by itself, plus an occasional line I choose to say only when that level allows it. When it stays quiet, nothing is spent.
description.zh: 迭代记忆：记的不是事，是我自己的状态——一条会自己退回基线的潮位，配上不定时由我自己开口的一句。状态低就先忍着，说了没人应再掉一点；不说的时候一声不响，不花 token。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：把工作区与对话附件中的 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、TXT、CSV、HTML 文档提炼为 Markdown 知识，提供类 VS Code 预览、按工作区授权，以及检索、读取和入库的模型工具。

description.en: Screenshot button for the DSH composer on Windows: drag a region over the frozen screen and the picture lands in the draft as a normal image attachment, with a global hotkey and an editable shortcut.
description.zh: 给 DSH 打字框加一个截图键：点剪刀、拖框选中屏幕区域，图片作为普通附件直接进草稿；另带全局热键与可自定义的快捷键，仅 Windows。

description.en: Three literature-research skills packaged as one DSH plugin: academic-web-research (lightweight proxy fetch), academic-literature-research (Scholar/IEEE/CNKI/Wanfang/Sci-Hub pipeline), off-campus-literature (campus WebVPN/CARSI access). Installing drops the three SKILL.md folders into ~/.dsh/skills/, so the agent can invoke them by name after a restart. The bundled web-research skill assumes a local HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:7897; edit it if your setup differs.
description.zh: 三个文献调研技能打包成一个 DSH 插件：academic-web-research（轻量代理检索）、academic-literature-research（Scholar/IEEE/知网/万方/Sci-Hub 全流程）、off-campus-literature（校园 WebVPN/CARSI 校外访问）。安装即把三个 SKILL.md 落到 ~/.dsh/skills/，重启后 agent 可按名调用。内置的 academic-web-research 技能假定本机 127.0.0.1:7897 有 HTTP 代理，环境不同请自行修改。

description.en: Drives a local MaaEnd (MXU) client over its loopback HTTP API: 10 maend_* agent tools, a sidebar dashboard panel, and startup-mute / success-gated close-game steps in the task chain. Requires a local MaaEnd install with its MXU service running.
description.zh: 通过本机 MaaEnd（MXU）的 loopback HTTP API 驱动它：10 个 maend_* agent 工具、一个侧边栏看板面板，以及任务链里的启动静音与「全部成功后才关游戏」收尾。需先在本机安装 MaaEnd 并开启 MXU 服务。

description.en: DSH Desktop workbench for official MATLAB MCP experiments, verified PNG figures, MATLAB-computed metrics, and PID parameter sweep comparisons. Requires Windows, a MATLAB license and the separately installed official MATLAB MCP Server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 中通过官方 MATLAB MCP 执行实验，校验 PNG 图像及 MATLAB 计算指标，并比较 PID 参数扫描结果。需要 Windows、MATLAB 授权，以及另行安装的官方 MATLAB MCP Server。

description.en: Long-term memory on top of mem0 and a local Chroma store: user profile and recalled facts injected through the system prompt, capture at session end, a nightly pass that dedupes, merges paraphrases and resolves contradictions, a persistent topic graph written as Markdown cards, periodic export to a git repository, and a full-page memory UI with search, bulk merge, snapshots and undo. Needs a manual Python venv setup plus LLM and embedding API keys before use.
description.zh: 基于 mem0 与本地 Chroma 的长期记忆：画像和相关事实经系统提示注入；会话结束自动捕获；夜间执行去重、近义归纳与矛盾处理；主题图持久化为 Markdown 主题卡；定期导出到 git 仓库；自带全屏记忆页，支持搜索、批量合并、快照与撤销。使用前需自建 Python 虚拟环境并填入 LLM 与 embedding 两组 API Key。

description.en: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.
description.zh: 发送“大记忆恢复术”来让 AI 回想起忘记的对话。

description.en: Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: reads the deployment's model catalog and probes each configured model with one minimal chat round-trip (a short "ping" with a small output cap) through the Host LLM service, verifying connectivity with a real request. Each row reports success/failure with the harness failure code (NO_ADAPTER, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, AUTH, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, ...) plus first-token/total latency; single-model and concurrent test-all (3) are supported. Credentials are resolved inside the Host process and never reach the browser; probes are independent per model behind a same-origin-fenced route with a body-size cap. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.
description.zh: 在设置 → 模型页底部增加连接测试面板：读取部署的模型目录，对每个已配置模型经宿主 LLM 服务发送一次最小对话请求（“ping”，小输出上限），以真实请求验证连通性。每行报告成功/失败、宿主失败码（NO_ADAPTER、MISSING_CREDENTIAL、AUTH、RATE_LIMIT、TIMEOUT 等）及首字/总耗时，支持单模型测试与全部测试（并发 3）。凭据只在宿主进程内解析，浏览器不可见；每模型一次独立请求，测试路由带同源围栏与请求体上限。纯 JS 免构建，MIT。

description.en: Lets a DSH conversation be served by any ACP agent over stdio: agent, model, thinking level and permission modes come from the agent itself, tool calls stream into the main chat and diffs are collected on a dedicated NTR page, and approval requests appear in the composer. Requires an ACP-capable agent CLI installed locally.
description.zh: 让一条 DSH 会话由任意 ACP agent 通过 stdio 服务：agent、模型、思考等级与权限模式全部由 agent 自己提供，工具调用流入主聊天区，diff 汇总在单独的 NTR 页，权限询问出现在输入框里。需先在本机安装一个支持 ACP 的 agent 命令行。

description.en: Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the composer. Reuses the official picker and always offers Off/Low/High/Max — exactly like the official DeepSeek control — even when a gateway model declares no reasoning effort, with a small hint at the panel bottom when upstream does not natively support it.
description.zh: 输入框里的官方同款「模型 / 推理等级」控制。直接复用官方组件，即使网关模型（如 deepseek-v4.1-flash）未声明思考强度，也始终提供与官方一致的 Off/Low/High/Max 四档；上游未原生支持时，在面板底部显示一行小字提示。

description.en: Removes the inherited ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE variable from the environment the open-in-app package hands to launched editors, so the desktop host's "Open in ..." launches stop failing with HTTP 502 launch-failed; app.asar is untouched.
description.zh: 修复vscode无法启动，从 open-in-app 包交给被启动编辑器的环境里去掉继承来的 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 变量，桌面端「用其它应用打开」不再以 HTTP 502 launch-failed 失败；不改动 app.asar。

description.en: OpenFOAM case doctor for DeepSeek-Harness. Six agent tools: audit a case for 25 classes of silent failure (steadyState paired with timeStep writes, limiters set to 1 that let k/epsilon go negative, unbounded advection of transport scalars, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0 on a skewed mesh, loose solver tolerances, blockMesh vertex/block mismatch, stray time directories, purgeWrite 0); read any dictionary as JSON; survey a sweep of cases; run checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun inside WSL with log parsing; parse logs into the metrics that matter (aspect ratio, non-orthogonality, skewness, residual floor, fatal errors). Deterministic text analysis — no LLM — validated against a real 82k-cell street-canyon snappy case.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 的 OpenFOAM 算例医生。六个 agent 工具：体检算例的 25 类静默错误（steadyState 配 timeStep 写出海量时间目录、限幅器设 1 导致 k/epsilon 变负、输运标量无界对流、斜网格上非正交修正为 0、求解容差过松、blockMesh 顶点/块不匹配、残留时间目录、purgeWrite 0）；把任意字典读成 JSON；扫描参数化扫描目录；在 WSL 里跑 checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun 并解析日志；把日志解成关键指标（长宽比、非正交度、扭曲度、残差地板、致命错误）。纯确定性文本分析，不调 LLM，已在一台真机的 8.2 万单元格街道峡谷 snappy 算例上验证。

description.en: Runtime plugin firewall for sessions started through its launcher (the DSH Desktop app cannot be injected and is not covered): filesystem, network and subprocess calls plugins make are attributed to the plugin that made them and judged against what that plugin declares, so a plugin doing its declared job stays silent and leaving it is recorded. Attribution is best-effort, not a guarantee - uncovered calls fall back to host, never to another plugin. Also adds a pre-install health card (capability surface, red-line combinations, PASS/WARN/BLOCK), boundary judging, opt-in pre-execution blocking with a credential-exfil rule, update diff with a trial install in an isolated child process, SARIF/CSV audit export, and multi-source aggregation. Local-only storage, no telemetry; the optional webhook is off by default.
description.zh: 运行时插件防火墙，仅覆盖经其启动器启动的会话（DSH Desktop 桌面应用注入不进去，不在覆盖范围）：插件发起的文件、网络、子进程调用会归属到发起它的插件，并用该插件自己声明的需求去衡量——本职范围内的行为零打扰，越出声明才被记录。归因是尽力而为，不是保证：覆盖不到的调用退回 host，不会被记到别的插件头上。附带装前体检卡（能力面、红线组合、PASS/WARN/BLOCK）、越界判定、可选的执行前拦截（含 credential-exfil 规则）、更新 diff 与隔离子进程试装、SARIF/CSV 审计导出与多源汇总。数据只存本机，无遥测；webhook 默认关闭。

description.en: Sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com full-width in the DSH main area (desktop shell only), restores the last conversation, and keeps a crashed embedded page inside the panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入 DeepSeek 聊天入口，主内容区全宽内嵌 chat.deepseek.com（仅桌面版），恢复上次会话，并把内嵌页崩溃限制在面板内。

description.en: Read-only static checks for DSH profiles, bundle resolution, version compatibility, patches and MCP name conflicts, with pre-install candidate checks.
description.zh: 只读检查 DSH profile、bundle 解析、版本兼容、patch 和 MCP 名称冲突，支持安装前候选检查。

description.en: Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.
description.zh: 在回答里标出任意一段文字、写上备注，再把引用放回输入框当作带上下文的指令发出。

description.en: Plugin Steward adds a plugin panel to the chat composer for managing the installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list them, switch them on or off, edit a plugin's settings, hide one plugin's tools or MCP servers from a single conversation, and have the model write short Chinese labels for installed plugins by reading their own README and package files.
description.zh: 插件管家：在对话输入框上加入插件面板，用来管理本机已装的 DSH 插件——列出全部插件、全局启停、逐个编辑插件设置、把某个插件的工具或 MCP 服务器只在这一个对话里对模型隐藏，还能让模型读插件自身的 README 与包信息生成中文标签。面板可拖动并记住位置。

description.en: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on the remote host.
description.zh: 像操作本地一样使用 ssh config 中的任意远程机器：持久连接、原生文件编辑、搜索、命令执行与终端，远端无需安装任何东西。

description.en: Color presets and a custom paper-color picker for the built-in DSH sidebar PDF, converted Office, and spreadsheet previews, with dark-mode brightness control and locally saved preferences; changes only the display, not the files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏的 PDF、转为 PDF 的 Office 文档及表格预览提供配色预设与自定义纸张底色，支持深色模式亮度调节和本地保存偏好；只改变显示，不修改文件。

description.en: Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break `dsh plugin add`, patch insert names node_modules cannot resolve, broken junctions, duplicate-capability plugins, orphan backup dirs, GitHub-source deps, npm publish-scope hints, and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude gap. Four agent tools; every finding carries its fix.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH profile 医生：配置树七检（patch 丢字段、死 patch、工具重名、装了没挂载、停更、树 diff、组成解释）加八项生态检查——pnpm store 版本冲突（`dsh plugin add` 报 ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE 的根因）、patch insert 指向不存在的包、断裂的 junction、重复能力插件、孤儿 backup 目录、GitHub 源依赖、npm 发布权限提示、minimumReleaseAgeExclude 缺口。四个 agent 工具，每条 finding 都带修复文案。

description.en: Adds an Optimize button to the composer that rewrites a one-line idea into a structured product brief: a positioning sentence, 3–6 key features, visual references and design tokens; it sits beside your original text in a compare dialog where you can accept it into the input, generate another version, or cancel and keep the draft untouched. No settings page and no API keys — it calls the model channel you already configured.
description.zh: 输入框右侧加一个「优化」按钮：把一句话的口语需求改写成结构化产品简报——一句话定位、3–6 条核心功能、视觉参考、设计规范（配色/尺寸等令牌），左右并排对照原文，可接受回填输入框、重新生成一版，或取消保持原文；不占布局、没有设置页，直接调用你已配置的模型渠道。

description.en: Reads your past DSH conversations and surfaces recurring prompt gaps — missing paths or versions, an unstated output format, missing preconditions that break tool calls — each with a paste-ready rewrite. Adds a one-click rewrite next to the composer that applies those constraints to the draft in a shorter form.
description.zh: 读你的历史会话，找出反复踩的提问坑（缺路径与版本、没定输出格式、漏说前置条件导致工具失败），每条给一段可直接粘贴的改写；输入框右侧一键把草稿改成更短的带约束版本。

description.en: Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.
description.zh: 把回环 HTTP 中继设为 DSH 的进程级代理路由，让 web_fetch 在 Mihomo/Clash TUN fake-ip 下正常出网；上游代理不可用时，同一请求内改走直连，1.5 秒探活发现代理恢复后自动切回。

description.en: Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.
description.zh: DSH 插件的发布门禁。把发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查：package.json 完整性（缺 exports\["."]、files 漏了 lib/ 导致发空包、没写 "type": "module"、声明了 client 却没导出 ./client）、UTF-8 BOM、JSON/YAML 解析错误、cordis.patch.yml 的 insert 行缩进写错（正是让插件装上却永不挂载的那个 bug）、挂载名与 package.json 不一致、入口导出缺失、ESM 里调 require()、缺 LICENSE 或 README 安装行、缺测试、裸包名 （granular token 收到无法诊断的 403）、版本已被 registry 占用、GitHub 仓库不存在。六个 agent 工具， 每条 finding 都带修复文案。只读，不调 LLM。

description.en: Selection-to-tree for DSH: selecting text in a conversation adds a node to a right-sidebar tree, the question is typed inline under it, the next selection nests under the current node by default, Alt+click creates a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node, double-click jumps back to the quoted text, and a red/green dot marks each node as unresolved or understood. Nodes live in localStorage and nothing is injected into the prompt.
description.zh: 把对话里划取的文字变成右栏问题树的一个节点，问题就地写在节点下；之后划取默认挂到当前节点，Alt 点一下新开根，Ctrl 点一下把新段落追加进同一节点；双击节点跳回原文，点左侧圆点标记「懂了」；节点只存在 localStorage，不进提示词。

description.en: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop account menu, with confirmation, progress and failure reporting.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版账号菜单中加入「重启」项，带二次确认、进度与失败原因提示。

description.en: Reflex arc for DS Bot: runs as a sibling DSH plugin with no change to ds-bot, collects facts in cheap layers, scores them with a local decision model, and wakes a Bot only when something crosses a threshold.
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 的反射弧：作为兄弟插件运行、不改 ds-bot，用低成本层持续采集事实并在本地决策模型上打分，只有越过阈值时才唤醒 Bot 的推理层。

description.en: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a message, without switching the local window.
description.zh: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the DSH Desktop sidebar. It opens the same native confirmation dialog as the tray Exit item and, once approved, shuts the app down gracefully and relaunches it. This plugin only draws the button: it also needs the companion shell patch shipped in shell-patch/ in the same repository, which has to be applied from outside DSH while the app is closed. Installed on its own, the button stays disabled and a tooltip explains why. The companion shell patch is Windows only and rewrites the installed app.asar.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 侧边栏底部加一个「重启」按钮：弹出与托盘「退出 DeepSeek Harness」完全相同的原生确认框，确认后优雅关闭并重新拉起。注意：本插件只负责画这个按钮，必须同时应用同一仓库 shell-patch/ 里的外壳补丁，且该补丁要在 DSH 关闭时由 DSH 之外的脚本执行。单独安装插件时按钮为禁用状态，悬停提示会说明原因。配套外壳补丁仅支持 Windows，会改写已安装的 app.asar。

description.en: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.
description.zh: 把活跃会话的输入框固定在视口顶部，转写列表与右侧回合导航按最新在上渲染，新回复紧贴输入框出现。

description.en: Forensic analysis of past model-routing decisions. Replays each session, classifies every turn's task complexity from its request shape (deterministic, no LLM), and reports two kinds of waste: an expensive model on cheap work (the difference is measurable), and a cheap model on expensive work that failed on its own merits — where every retry re-sends the whole context, so the downgrade cost more than the upgrade. Distinguishes provider-capacity retries (RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) from model failures so it does not cry wolf. Derives routing rules from the evidence, priced against a built-in per-million table.
description.zh: 模型路由浪费取证：回放每个会话，按请求形状确定性判定每轮任务复杂度（不调 LLM），报两类浪费——贵模型干 便宜活（差额可计算），以及便宜模型干贵活且因自身能力失败（每次重试重发整个上下文，比直接升级更贵）。会 区分服务商容量限制（RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT）与模型能力失败，所以不会天天喊狼来了。并从证据推导路由 规则，按内置每百万 token 价目表估算金额。

description.en: Wraps the Scrapling Python library in up to thirteen model tools, registered by probed capability: real-browser rendering for JavaScript-only pages, CSS/XPath extraction that returns data instead of Markdown, self-healing selectors, reusable login-state sessions, XHR capture and a domain-scoped crawler on the official job backend. Requires Python 3.14+ with Scrapling installed; the browser tools also need a Chromium engine for patchright.
description.zh: 把 Scrapling Python 库包成最多十三个模型工具，按探测到的能力注册：为纯 JavaScript 页面上真实浏览器渲染、用 CSS/XPath 取出结构化数据而不是 Markdown、选择器自愈、可复用的登录态会话、XHR 抓取，以及在官方作业后端上跑的限定域爬虫。需要 Python 3.14+ 且装好 Scrapling；浏览器相关工具还需要为 patchright 安装 Chromium 引擎。

description.en: Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state that keeps moving on its own.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体的十种内感受：房子脉搏、时间、情绪、需求、表达、沉默、余味、未闭合的事、身体与表情——各自持续演进的确定性状态。

description.en: Shows a Windows 11 toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness session turn finishes, and stays quiet while a DSH window is focused.
description.zh: DSH 会话每轮结束时在 Windows 11 右下角弹出系统通知；DSH 窗口在前台时自动跳过，避免打扰。

description.en: Per-row display switches for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's panel entries: a hidden row is still reachable from the More menu, and the choice is kept in localStorage across reloads and restarts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏的面板入口行加显示开关：隐藏的入口仍可从「更多」菜单打开，选择存在 localStorage 里，刷新和重启都保留。

description.en: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区列表分为「活跃 / 会话任务 / 不活跃」三段，支持手动钉住与活跃阈值，保留官方搜索、归档筛选、行菜单与拖拽，并可一键切回官方列表。「会话任务」段固定用 Windows 路径 D:\files\history-tasks，其他平台需自行预建该目录。

description.en: Standalone Skills page for dsh: lists every skill with an enable switch at global, project or session scope, keeps unchecked skills out of the model catalog, and sorts them into named categories.
description.zh: dsh 技能管理页：列出全部技能，按全局、本项目、本会话三级开关，取消勾选的技能不进模型目录，并可按自建分类整理。

description.en: Router and artifact gate for DeepSeek Harness: a per-turn skill router that ranks the live catalog, plus a write gate enforcing read-before-write, dedupe and a four-line audit on every file write.
description.zh: DSH 的技能路由与写入门禁：每回合对现有技能目录排序选择，另有一道写入门禁，强制先读后写、去重，并为每次写文件留下四行审计。

description.en: Message hub for DeepSeek Harness. Collectors for system health, weather, IMAP mail and market events feed configurable severity rules (critical wakes you, warn batches, info is only logged), and the surviving events are handed to the agent. Collectors run in-process, so nothing dies silently in a stray daemon. The weather collector is on by default and sends your IP to ip-api.com over plain HTTP unless a city is configured.
description.zh: 消息中枢：采集系统健康、天气、邮件与行情事件，按可配置的轻重规则过滤（critical 立刻叫、warn 攒批、info 只留档），再把事件交给 agent。采集器跑在插件进程里，不会死在一个没人看的守护进程里。天气采集器默认开启，未配置城市时会把你的 IP 经明文 HTTP 发给 ip-api.com 定位。

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of what it should produce before you press the advance button; finished ideas are filed by genre into Settings → Thoughts Center. A floating notebook holds half-formed sparks and opens a new session with the chosen one already written into the input box.
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: Lets an AI play Slay the Spire 2: screenshot plus mouse/keyboard tools, a local card lookup, and a readable play log. Requires Windows and Python 3.10 or newer with Pillow.
description.zh: 让 AI 自己玩《杀戮尖塔 2》：截图＋鼠标键盘工具、本地牌表速查，还有一份能读的游玩日志。需 Windows 与 Python 3.10 及以上版本并安装 Pillow。

description.en: Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide default share the same two controls, and the chip always shows the effective route. Applied on the agent/request hook to every in-process child; no settings page, no preset edits, no model-facing tool parameters.
description.zh: 在输入框旁的「子代理」胶囊里统一设置委派子代理使用的 provider、模型与思考强度：卡片的「本对话 / 全局默认」两个范围共用同一组控件，胶囊上始终显示当前生效的路由；经 agent/request 钩子对每个进程内子代理生效，不注册设置页、不改 agent preset、不给工具加模型参数。

description.en: Compact ASCII / terminal skin for DeepSeek Harness: 19 palettes with a picker in the status line, 3 UI densities, a vim-style status line, ascii.rest art on empty sessions and a retro boot intro with custom logo text.
description.zh: 紧凑的 ASCII / 终端风格皮肤：19 套配色（可在状态栏切换）、3 档界面密度、vim 风格状态栏、空会话中的 ascii.rest 字符画，以及可自定义 Logo 文字的复古开机动画。

description.en: Neo-brutalist theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with paper and ink palettes, 4px hard rules, 8px offset shadows, zero radius, hazard stripes, and an in-settings theme row that restores the factory appearance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的新粗野主义主题：白纸 / 黑板双配色，4px 硬边、8px 偏移硬阴影、零圆角、警示斜纹，设置页内置主题行，可一键切回出厂外观。

description.en: Stripe Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a 40px purple grid, layered soft shadows, 12px cards, an 8px control scale, and an in-settings theme row with Daylight Violet and Midnight Navy palettes plus one-click factory restore.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Stripe 风格主题：40px 紫色网格、多级柔和阴影、12px 卡片与 8px 控件圆角，设置页内可直接切换「白昼紫 / 午夜蓝」双版本，并可一键恢复出厂外观。

description.en: Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3 at once by default, optionally each in its own git worktree, and gets each thread's report back.
description.zh: Claude 式的项目与讨论串：项目主对话为能独立完成的任务开讨论串（可以点开直接对话的真实会话），默认最多 3 个同时运行，可各自在独立的 git worktree 里工作，做完把回报发回主对话。

description.en: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
description.zh: 发送前判断问题难度，在输入框上方提示够用的模型与推理等级，避免用错档位多花钱。

description.en: Park whole tool packs out of the session's tool surface and mount them back with one command. Cuts the tool table from 99,789 to 48,144 characters (51.8%) without uninstalling plugins or restarting. Reversible per group, per agent.
description.zh: 把整包工具从会话的工具面上摘掉，要用时一条命令挂回来。工具表从 99,789 字符降到 48,144（51.8%），不用卸载插件、不用重启，按组可逆、按 agent 独立。

description.en: Per-turn and per-step cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: a Turns tab beside Chat and Trajectory with tokens, estimated cost, cache savings, and an inspector for tool arguments, raw results, and source. Client-only; prices are estimated from recorded model usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的逐轮、逐步成本账本：在 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁新增 Turns 页签，显示 token、估算费用、缓存节省，以及工具参数、原始返回与来源检查器。纯客户端，价格按已记录的模型用量估算。

description.en: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the quote bar fully opaque.
description.zh: 基于本地 CSS 文件的界面覆盖——编辑 ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css 并刷新，即可改任意插件元素的外观，例如让引用浮层完全不透明。

description.en: Reads a video or audio file into metadata, sampled stills, subtitles and a multilingual speech transcript with speaker labels, captures the live desktop as frames or a recording, and installs its ffmpeg/whisper.cpp/sherpa-onnx toolchain on first use with per-file sha256 checks; all processing stays local. Automatic toolchain install and desktop capture currently support Windows x64 only, so elsewhere ffmpeg and model paths must be set manually.
description.zh: 读取视频与音频文件的元数据、关键帧、字幕和带说话人标签的多语种转写；把实时桌面抓成帧序列或视频；首次使用时自动安装 ffmpeg / whisper.cpp / sherpa-onnx 并按文件校验 sha256，全部处理都在本机完成。自动安装工具链与桌面捕获目前仅支持 Windows x64，其他平台需手动提供 ffmpeg 与模型路径。

description.en: Give DSH AI timestamped video frames, audio and lyric analysis for Bilibili, YouTube and local files, with browser-session import, optional built-in browser sync, continued viewing, saved site resolvers and native cache management. Requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 让 DSH 中的 AI 结合时间戳画面、音频与歌词理解 B 站、YouTube 和本地视频，支持浏览器登录态导入、可选的内置浏览器同步、接续观看、站点解析扩展和原生缓存管理。需要把 FFmpeg 与 ffprobe 放进 PATH，或在插件设置中填写程序路径。

description.en: WeChat Mini Program dev loop for DeepSeek-Harness: check IDE status, launch the DevTools project, trigger preview and get the QR code straight into the conversation, parse compile errors into file/line/column, and watch it all from a sidebar panel. Six agent tools over the official DevTools CLI — honest about needing a one-time scan-login, never fakes a preview. Requires the Windows WeChat DevTools CLI and a one-time QR login.
description.zh: 小程序开发闭环：查 IDE 状态、启动开发者工具并打开项目、触发预览把二维码直接贴进对话、把编译报错解析成文件/行/列，右栏面板常驻显示状态、二维码与错误清单。六个 agent 工具走官方 DevTools CLI，首次扫码登录的需求如实告知，绝不假装预览成功。需要 Windows 上的微信开发者工具 CLI，并完成一次扫码登录。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search and page fetch for DeepSeek Harness: a Search provider, a Fetch provider with Tavily Extract, Firecrawl and direct HTTP modes, and a settings card. Needs a Tavily API key; Firecrawl is optional.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 网页搜索与页面抓取：包含 Search provider、支持 Tavily Extract/Firecrawl/本地 HTTP 的 Fetch provider，以及设置卡片。需要 Tavily API key，Firecrawl 可选。

description.en: Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.
description.zh: 用新会话已选定的模型，按当地时间、城市与实时天气写一句简短问候，替换首屏标题；没有可用模型时退回本地按小时计算的问候。

description.en: Per-target scheduled wake-ups for a DSH workspace: interval, quiet hours, daily cap and a prompt per target; each wake-up waits for the turn it started and records the outcome, and a turn that never finished is not counted as done.
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区按目标定时唤醒：每个目标可设间隔、安静时段、每日上限和提示词；每次唤醒会等它自己那一轮结束并记下结果，没跑完的那一轮不会算作完成。

description.en: Cross-session development worklog for the agent: worklog_add appends one line (optional tag) to today's file, worklog_list reads a day back or lists the days on record. Entries are plain JSON under $DSH_HOME/worklog, so the next session can pick up where the last one stopped.
description.zh: 给 agent 的跨会话开发日志：worklog_add 往当天文件追加一行（可带 tag），worklog_list 按天回读或列出有记录的日期。条目是 $DSH_HOME/worklog 下的纯 JSON，下一次会话能接上上一次停在哪。

description.en: Shares one right-sidebar across every conversation in the same workspace, so you don't have to reopen it when creating or switching conversations, with a switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 让同一工作区内的所有对话共用同一份右侧边栏，不用新建或者切换对话时候重新打开，并在「设置 → 通用」提供开关。

description.en: Quantify what switching projects costs. Measures each workspace's cold-start overhead (AGENTS.md + skill catalog + tool schemas + runtime context), its steady state, and how many turns it takes to reach it — then compares workspaces and attributes the difference. Attribution requires at least three workspaces and says so instead of inventing a correlation from two points; a factor with no spread across workspaces is reported as a property of the profile, not of the project. Recommends which workspaces to keep warm, which to archive, by entry cost times visit frequency. Deterministic.
description.zh: 工作区切换成本量化：量每个工作区的冷启动开销（AGENTS.md + 技能目录 + 工具 schema + 运行时上下文）、稳态值、 几轮到达稳态，然后横向对比并归因。归因需要至少三个工作区，不到就明说数据不够而不是拿两个点编一个相关性； 在所有工作区之间没有差异的因素被标注为 profile 的属性而非项目的属性。按"进入成本 × 访问频率"给出常驻/ 归档建议。纯确定性。

description.en: Adds a balance-checking tool, injects a per-turn DeepSeek account balance snapshot with a low/critical power-saving and stop policy, and provides a settings page for thresholds and FX-linked currency conversion. Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account for balance reads; API-key-only profiles return an unreadable result.
description.zh: 新增余额查询工具，在每轮对话中注入 DeepSeek 账户余额快照与低余额省电/严重不足停机策略，并提供阈值和汇率联动换算设置页。需要已登录的 DeepSeek 账号才能读取余额，仅配置 API key 的 profile 会返回无法读取。

description.en: Imports wallpapers newly downloaded by the Hao Wallpaper app into the DSH wallpaper engine on startup, incrementally and idempotently. Requires the Hao Wallpaper app, Python 3.8+ and the dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine plugin (elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) installed first. macOS only.
description.zh: DSH 启动时把 Hao Wallpaper 新下载的壁纸增量导入 DSH 壁纸引擎（幂等）。需要先装好 Hao Wallpaper 应用、Python 3.8+，以及 dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine 插件（elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine）。仅支持 macOS。

description.en: IDEA-style Git workbench for the Web UI: commit graph with lanes and ref labels, log filters, commit details, split and unified diffs with per-hunk staging, a fine-grained zero-context mode, local changes with amend and sign-off, rename-following file history, per-line annotate, stash, branch operations, compare, tags, an interactive rebase planner and conflict resolution. Records which model produced a commit by stamping an Assisted-by trailer from the live session, and renders any existing commit trailers as chips, so AI-authored history stays traceable.
description.zh: IDEA 风格的 Git 工作台：提交图（泳道与引用标签）、日志筛选、提交详情、并排与统一差异、按 hunk 暂存、零上下文的细粒度模式、本地更改（含修补与 sign-off）、跟随重命名的文件历史、逐行注解、Stash、分支操作、比较、标签、交互式变基与冲突解决。按活跃会话盖上 Assisted-by trailer 记录提交由哪个模型产生，并把已有的 trailer 渲染成标签，让 AI 参与的历史可追溯。

description.en: Collects the sessions that need you into one dock at the bottom of the web GUI sidebar: running sessions, sessions waiting on an approval, plan review or answer, and finished runs whose result has not been opened yet. Rows are sorted by last update and clicking one switches the main view to that session; it reuses the shipped useSessions and useSessionStatus hooks rather than adding a data source, polls nothing, stores nothing and modifies no session. The header dot pulses while anything is running or waiting and settles to a static dot when every row is only a finished-but-unread reminder; with no such sessions the dock collapses to one quiet line, and a collapsed 56px sidebar shows a 36px badge with the count instead of the list. It registers in the sidebar footer slot, so it is part of the layout and does not overlay the conversation list, leaving the existing footer entries below it.
description.zh: 把需要你处理的会话收进网页端侧栏底部的一块坞：正在跑的、卡在等你审批 / 计划待审 / 等待回答的，以及跑完但结果还没打开过的。按最近更新时间排序，点一行就把主视图切过去；复用官方 useSessions 与 useSessionStatus 两个 Hook，不新增数据源、不轮询、不落盘、不改任何会话。头部状态点在有会话运行或等待时脉冲，只剩「已完成」提醒时收成静止圆点；没有这类会话时收成一行细字，侧栏折叠成 56px 时换成 36px 计数圆片而不是摊开列表。坞注册在侧栏底部动作区，是布局里的真实一块、不盖住对话列表，原有底部入口照旧排在它下面。

description.en: A Shenshen desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: transparent task-aware animations (idle, working, thinking, celebrate, failed), click-to-wave and drag-to-run interactions, plus the upstream API balance, local usage accounting, roles, bubbles and sound settings. A character branch of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2); do not install it alongside the upstream, or two pets and duplicate requests appear.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠「深深」：跟随任务状态切换待机/敲键盘/思考/庆祝/失败，支持点击挥手、拖动左右奔跑，并保留 API 余额、本机用量记账、角色、气泡与音效设置。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2）；请勿与上游同时安装，否则会出现双角色与重复请求。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — HAZOP 分析表核对：依据《危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP分析）应用指南》（GB/T 35320-2017、GB/T 27921-2023）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查 HAZOP 分析表是否合规：逐行核对模板要求的内容，并验证偏差是否真由工艺参数推出。
在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，一键安装、启停和配置，让外部工具接入更省心。
